history.body: Hi, I came across Pearl Residences while browsing around Seberang Jaya. What’s the general price range there? I’m just trying to get a feel for the area and options.

The available base-price references for Pearl Residences are roughly RM328k–RM358k, depending on floor and facing. That’s a reference range, not a confirmed current all-in quote: the exact car-park configuration and current package can affect the final figure, so I’d confirm the latest schedule before quoting it. The homes are 900 sq. ft., with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. If you have a rough budget in mind, I can help narrow down which options may be relevant.
I don’t have a clear budget yet; I’m just starting to compare options. Please let me know once you’ve confirmed the current range and what the car-park configuration does to the total.

Understood—you don’t need to settle on a budget while you’re comparing. The current price and package details are still awaiting confirmation, so I can’t confirm the latest all-in figures yet. The pricing material lists car-park premiums of RM15k, RM20k or RM30k, depending on the unit category and configuration; I can’t safely add one of those to the earlier RM328k–RM358k base reference without the matching schedule. I’ll update you with the confirmed range and corresponding car-park costs once they’re available.
